context: A degree by itself no longer stands out — employers want evidence you can build. That hits freshers in Dehradun directly — a North India centre running on education and a large institutional base, government and IT parks, tourism and services and the graduate and early-career job market, where the ones who can put AI to work are pulling ahead. Its IT parks and education base are hiring for AI.

So ONROL's course for freshers is hands-on from day one. You ship genuine AI projects, and use AI itself to speed up studying and the job search on cases from Dehradun's own economy and end with two or three shipped AI projects that lift a fresher's portfolio above the pile — role-specific, not a one-size-fits-all overview.

You leave with a portfolio a Dehradun employer can open and trust, and the confidence to keep building. Learners join live from Rajpur Road, Sahastradhara Road, Clement Town and Ballupur — no relocation, evenings and weekends available.

faqs.q: Is the Dehradun course online?
faqs.a: Entirely online and live. Whether you're in Rajpur Road, Sahastradhara Road, Clement Town or Ballupur, it's the same hands-on cohort — no travel, no career gap.

faqs.q: Is coding required for freshers to join?
faqs.a: Not at all. Designed for freshers rather than developers, it has you build with no-/low-code tools and AI copilots, teaching any technical bits as they come up.

faqs.q: How is this different from a generic AI course?
faqs.a: It is applied to your role and your city: you ship genuine AI projects, and use AI itself to speed up studying and the job search, on scenarios from Dehradun's the graduate and early-career job market, and finish with two or three shipped AI projects that lift a fresher's portfolio above the pile.

faqs.q: Is there a portfolio outcome?
faqs.a: Yes: two or three shipped AI projects that lift a fresher's portfolio above the pile. Something a Dehradun employer can actually open and trust, not just a certificate.
